decisions.claim: Whether the GDT092 lexical-like PAGE_HOST layer warrants direct content-lexicon interpretation, rather than remaining one of the unresolved content-address realizations retained by GDT100.

scope_applicability.applies_to: Only the direct semantic-lexicon commitment and its claimed external grounding; not the whole compiler grammar or every possible lexical interpretation.
The stated revision rationale and unresolved address alternatives, not rejection of the later whole model.

decisions.actually_tested_falsifier: No single comprehensive semantic falsifier was executed by GDT100. Its synthesis cites several distinct external channels: GDT089 descriptor/representation search; GDT095 exhaustive eligible annotation-token channel with positive-overlap correction and ten-way selection charge; GDT096 frozen mixed spatial-token transfer to a hedged annotation stratum; and GDT099 full-library submotif/axis search. These test specific representations against human annotation endpoints, not the truth of all content lexica.
decisions.outcome: GDT100 explicitly calls GDT092's direct PAGE_HOST content-lexicon claim too strong. GDT095 best joint representation gains 1.605 aggregate bits but loses 1.717 after selection payment; GDT096 that interaction loses 1.325 bits, while PAGE_HOST trigrams show a limited positive marginal on only four mixed-context positives. GDT099 no motif survives global search; the strongest local p=.0086 becomes global max p=.6987. GDT089 os remains a two-locus, globally unconfirmed descriptor seed. The later model retains opaque PAGE_HOST, O/Y branch+tail and reusable motif+residual as ungrounded address possibilities.
decisions.failure_reason: Local inventory reuse and a viable record compiler do not identify a portable semantic vocabulary. The actual channels constrain different proposed external readouts; their negative or low-capacity outcomes cannot be pooled into a general meaning FAIL. GDT100 narrows its interpretation in response while preserving untested or unresolved address realizations.
decisions.decision_utility: Do not rerun generic host-count/local-structure demonstrations as a way to restore a direct lexicon. A prospective investigation must specify which address realization and independently owned external endpoint it would discriminate; otherwise more same-kind counts leave this source decision unchanged.

historical_source_conditions.statement: GDT092 and GDT100 announce six frozen nonsealed predictions, but this review did not open the prediction tables and does not reconstruct their exact gates. GDT099 calls a newly annotated endpoint a future use of its logged motif inventory. These statements are not permission to run a study.

requirements: A concrete documented source, representation, selection-cost or annotation error affecting one specified historical channel, with reproducible correction and its original comparison scope preserved.
pathways.effect: Reassess only the affected reported result; a corrected structural/external score still requires independent meaning binding.

requirements: Choose an explicit address realization and operational claim before evaluation; preserve the competing whole-host, branch-tail and submotif-residual alternatives where relevant.
Supply independently owned external referents/properties or roles linked to the textual targets, rather than reuse ambiguous annotation words as their own semantic interpretation.
Specify genuinely changed admissible evidence, capacity and evaluation units appropriate to that endpoint, with held-out validation and selection accounting where prediction/search is used.
pathways.effect: This would be a new bounded test, not automatic reopening or confirmation of the entire GDT092 model.

not_sufficient: More page-local PAGE_HOST counts or stronger compiler clustering alone.
Reusing the same exposed descriptor panel or selecting a favorable descriptor after seeing it.
Treating the four GDT096 mixed-context positives as independently identified spatial-word meanings.
A local motif p-value without full-library accounting.
More pages without a relevant independent endpoint; pages may improve capacity but cannot supply denotation by count alone.
Renaming a host an address, or replacing it by an untested submotif, without a predeclared discriminating prediction.

decisions.claim_ceiling: Historical source-revision assessment only. No automatic target-card verdict, universal lexical refutation, independent replication claim, semantic confirmation or rerun admission.

evidence.quote:
# GDT092 — strongest current HPR2 generative theory

## Leading theory

**HYBRID CONTENT LEXICON + ABBREVIATION + RECORD COMPILER**

Voynichese is best modeled as a page-conditioned technical record system.  A
PAGE_HOST sequence supplies the lexical-like local vocabulary.  Formal layers
select construction branches, record placement, rendering, and boundaries.
This is more coherent than ordinary compressed natural language alone and
more coherent than pure notation alone.

```text
PAGE := PAGE_PROFILE + LOCAL_HOST_LEXICON + LINE+
LINE := ENTRY? FIELD (DY_CHECKPOINT FIELD)* B3_CLOSE?
FIELD := OUTER_WRAPPER? LOCAL_O_OT_FRAME? PAGE_HOST RIGHT_FAMILY?

OUTER_WRAPPER:
    q -> O-base host, early
    d -> Y-base host, late
    ch/che/sh/s -> host/register conditional

PAGE_HOST := opaque host | O/Y base + tail/terminal
RIGHT_FAMILY := render(PAGE_HOST, register, wrapper)
```

This explains free/bound reuse: the same host may appear bare, wrapped, or
right-rendered because the host and compiler layers are distinct.  It explains
the dense q-X families without treating q as a sound or lexical morpheme.  It
explains Currier/register effects as compiler-profile shifts, line reset as
record serialization, DY as a field checkpoint, and repeated labels as reuse
of content hosts under different renderings.

The theory remains awkward in three places.  GDT003 transformation completion
does not beat string statistics.  Compiler-only features themselves cluster
by page.  Exact PAGE_HOSTs do not yet preserve complete visual-property
bundles; the strongest content seed (`os` with DARK_LEAF/LIGHT_ROOT) has only
two scored loci and fails global correction.  Therefore the model is explicit
enough to predict, but not ready to translate.

Six non-f84 predictions are frozen.  f84r remains completely sealed and no
f84r prediction is made here.

# GDT100 — revised HPR2 generative theory

## Leading theory

**HYBRID CONTENT ADDRESS + ABBREVIATION + RECORD COMPILER**

The best current generator is still hybrid, but GDT092's claim that PAGE_HOST
directly supplies a content lexicon was too strong. The safer and more useful
model is:

```text
PAGE  := PAGE_PROFILE + CONTENT_ADDRESS_INVENTORY + LINE+
LINE  := ENTRY? FIELD (DY_CHECKPOINT FIELD)* B3_CLOSE?
FIELD := OUTER_WRAPPER? O_OT_FRAME? CONTENT_ADDRESS RIGHT_FAMILY?

CONTENT_ADDRESS := opaque PAGE_HOST
                 | O/Y branch + tail
                 | reusable subhost motif + residual

q -> O branch, early          d -> Y branch, late
RIGHT_FAMILY -> register-conditioned rendering
```

The compiler half is the strongest part. q/O and d/Y transfer to unseen tails
and folios, RIGHT_FAMILY transfers by register, and line/reset/field structure
is pervasive. Those operations still do not beat string statistics as a
linguistic morphology model.

The content-address half is plausible but ungrounded. PAGE_HOSTs have page-local
inventory signal. The narrow GDT089 and GDT096 external leads favor PAGE_HOST
over compiler features in limited panels, but GDT095's exhaustive descriptor
channel does not pay selection and GDT099 finds no global submotif association.
`PCH` is the clearest concrete new candidate: a recurrent HB/S record-phase
host family with a domain-local pharmaceutical spatial-context association,
not a manuscript-wide spatial word.

This remains more coherent than compressed natural language alone or pure
notation alone because it explains formal reuse, register rendering, page
vocabulary, and record serialization together. It is not ready for translation.
Six new non-f84 predictions are frozen. f84r receives no prediction and remains
completely sealed.

# GDT089 — plant descriptor localization inside HPR2

## Outcome

**PAGE_HOST_DARK_LEAF_DESCRIPTOR_LEAD_WEAK_POSTSELECTED**

The strict panel has 85 unhedged human-local plant-label loci on six physical
folios.  Eight of eleven transparent descriptor patterns pass capacity.
For `DARK_LEAF`, PAGE_HOST trigrams gain +4.342
whole-folio-held bits and are positive on 5/6
folios.  Raw words lose 5.397 bits and compiler-only
features lose 9.104.  The same PAGE_HOST advantage
appears for `DARK` and `LIGHT_ROOT`, while several other descriptors are null
or negative.  The best descriptor/representation result does not survive the
24-way maximum search (p=0.3065).

The exact-host seed is concrete: `chos` on f100v and `cheosdy` on f88v reduce
to PAGE_HOST `os`; both independent human descriptions mention a dark leaf
and light roots.  This survives wrapper and DY variation but has only two
visually scored loci.  The corpus contains many unannotated `os` prose
occurrences, so no absence or semantic generality can yet be claimed.

This is the first HPR2 external panel where stripping compiler layers yields a
positive descriptor-specific held signal while raw and compiler-only forms are
negative.  It is still archive-selected, regex-selected, tiny, and globally
non-significant.  `os` remains an UNASSIGNED PAGE_HOST visual-association
hypothesis, not an English gloss.  f84r was absent before analysis.

# GDT095 — exhaustive plant-description channel

## Outcome

**EXHAUSTIVE_DESCRIPTOR_CHANNEL_NO_SELECTOR_PAID_HPR2_REPRESENTATION_AFTER_ZERO_OVERLAP_CORRECTION**

This exploratory pass takes every one of the 19 frequency-eligible
normalized human-description tokens on the complete 83-locus strict
pharmaceutical plant-label panel.  It does not select `DARK_LEAF` or any other
attractive phrase. Exact-feature representations now use only neighbors with
positive overlap and otherwise back off to the held-folio prevalence code.
This correction removes a prior lexicographic zero-overlap tie artifact.

The best representation is HOST_WRAPPER_JOINT at only
+1.605 aggregate bits and on 2/5 folios; its selector-paid
gain is -1.717. No representation pays the
ten-way selection cost.

PAGE_HOST character trigrams alone score -47.257 bits and
WRAPPER alone scores -245.395. The exhaustive external
channel therefore does not localize positive information to PAGE_HOST, its
compiler marginals, or their exact conjunctions.

A disclosed post-hoc decomposition gives PAGE_HOST×WRAPPER
+3.230 bits on four mixed spatial/context words (`base`,
`edge`, `ground`, `level`) and -1.625 on the other
fifteen tokens. These words can describe plant geometry, inscription position,
or panel relations and are not a pure layout class. Neither subset rescues the
aggregate channel. PAGE_HOST remains useful for
the narrow GDT089 lead, but the exhaustive vocabulary does not support it as a
general appearance-bearing layer. The split was inspected after vocabulary
exposure and is not confirmatory.
f84r was absent before the model and was not opened, retained, queried, joined,
scored, or targeted.

# GDT096 — layout-channel transfer

## Outcome

**GDT095_HOST_WRAPPER_SPATIAL_TOKEN_LEAD_FAILS_BUT_PAGE_HOST_MARGIN_HAS_LOW_CAPACITY_TRANSFER**

The exact GDT095 mixed spatial-token regex and representation grid were frozen, trained on
83 UNHEDGED section-P plant labels, and applied without target refitting to all
35 HEDGED labels. Every prediction excludes its physical folio. Only four
targets contain the frozen position vocabulary.

The GDT095 PAGE_HOST×WRAPPER lead loses 1.325 bits and
is negative on all five target folios. Its exact within-folio rank is
p=0.7051. PAGE_HOST trigrams instead gain
+6.183 bits on all five folios, versus raw trigrams at
+4.534; PAGE_HOST retains +2.861
bits after the ten-way selector and has exact max p
0.0011. The advantage over raw is only
+1.649 bits and the HEDGED endpoint contains
four positives. In those records the words can refer to plant base, ground
level, or panel edge, so this is a low-capacity mixed-context HPR2 marginal
lead, not semantic localization. The frozen construction interaction does not
transfer.

This is archived-data stress testing, not a pristine validation. HEDGED rows
are a different annotation-quality stratum and the source corpus was already
available. The miss nevertheless prevents promotion of the GDT095 association.
No role or gloss is assigned. f84r was absent and untouched.

# GDT099 — PAGE_HOST submotif / external-axis atlas

## Outcome

**SUBHOST_EXTERNAL_ASSOCIATIONS_POSTSELECTED_NONE_SURVIVE_GLOBAL_SEARCH**

Across all 560 non-f84 human-annotated loci on 21 physical folios, the
state-blind library contains 150 supported PAGE_HOST trigrams and
557 capacity-eligible motif×axis tests. The strongest is
`ry$ × REL_ENCLOSURE` with within-folio effect
+4.115, local p=0.0086, but
full-library max p=0.6987. No candidate survives global
search; 24 are retained as weak local leads.

The atlas contains recognizable continuations of earlier seeds—`^ok` and
`os$` with the archived PLANT axis, `ok$` with WATER_OR_APPARATUS, and several
relation-axis candidates—but their supports remain section/page concentrated.
This exhaustive motif layer does not establish that a reusable subhost is a
semantic stem. It is nevertheless the right hypothesis inventory for a future
newly annotated endpoint: motifs are smaller than whole PAGE_HOSTs and every
tried association is now logged rather than selected silently.

All semantic roles remain UNASSIGNED. f84r was filtered before analysis and
was not opened, retained, queried, joined, scored, or targeted.

original_assertion.SEM:2fd4e8bffbbed966bfea: GDT092's HPR2 model proposes a page-conditioned technical record system combining a lexical-like local PAGE_HOST inventory, abbreviation and a distinct compiler. PAGE consists of profile, local host lexicon and one or more lines; each line has optional entry, a field followed by zero or more DY-checkpoint/field repetitions, and optional B3 close. A field contains optional outer wrapper and local O/OT frame, a PAGE_HOST and optional right-family rendering. The authored wrapper restrictions are early q on O-base hosts, late d on Y-base hosts, and host/register-conditional ch/che/sh/s; PAGE_HOST may be opaque or O/Y base plus tail/terminal, and right rendering depends on host, register and wrapper. The hypothesized semantic host is reused bare, wrapped or rendered, without identifying q as a sound or lexical morpheme. This is a historical proposal, not demonstrated lexical identity: compiler features also cluster by page, transformation completion does not beat string statistics, and complete visual-property binding is absent. GDT100 subsequently calls the direct-host-as-content-lexicon claim too strong; preserve this earlier model rather than rewriting it as the later content-address alternative.
original_assertion.SEM:b2fb10dededfad16dc78: GDT100's revised HPR2 model retains hybrid content addresses, abbreviation and a record compiler while explicitly judging GDT092's direct PAGE_HOST content lexicon too strong. Its content address may be an opaque PAGE_HOST, an O/Y branch plus tail, or a reusable subhost motif plus residual. PAGE combines profile, content-address inventory and one or more lines; each line contains optional entry, a field followed by zero or more DY-checkpoint/field repetitions and optional B3 close. A field has an optional outer wrapper, an optional O/OT frame, a required content address and optional right-family rendering; q selects the early O branch, d the late Y branch, and right rendering is register-conditioned. The content-address interpretation remains plausible but ungrounded; the source does not establish linguistic morphology over string statistics, global submotif association, or a manuscript-wide spatial meaning for its domain-local PCH lead. This is the historical constrained revision of an existing named model, not a recovered lexicon or a global refutation of content-bearing text.

decisions.scope: GDT092 direct semantic-host commitment and the specific GDT100 revision rationale; not all host uses, all content models or the structural compiler.
decisions.more_pages: Conditional capacity benefit only; no new independent endpoint follows merely from page count.
